ItemID: 1; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My history already includes a 4K Fire TV Stick and a Fire TV television, so an HD stick adds little.
ItemID: 2; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa fits my Fire TV setup, but I do not have a clear need for another voice-control device right now.
ItemID: 3; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add simple voice control to a lamp alongside my connected-home devices.
ItemID: 4; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for its larger screen and Alexa controls, which fit my interest in connected-home equipment.
ItemID: 5; Title: TOZO T10 Bluetooth 5.3 Wireless Earbuds with Wireless Charging Case IPX8 Waterproof Stereo Headphones in Ear Built in Mic Headset Premium Sound with Deep Bass for Sport White (2022 Upgraded); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Earbuds do not address my current focus on home viewing and security equipment.
ItemID: 6; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The smart display interests me, but I would choose the larger Echo Show 8 rather than buy both.
ItemID: 7; Title: Samsung SSD 860 EVO 4TB 2.5 Inch SATA III Internal SSD (MZ-76E4T0B/AM); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not planning a computer storage upgrade, and my recent devices do not establish a need for this internal drive.
ItemID: 8; Title: Seagate Expansion 16TB External Hard Drive HDD - USB 3.0, with Rescue Data Recovery Services (STKP16000402); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Recording video makes storage relevant, but I have no clear need for a 16TB external drive right now.
ItemID: 9; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my television and monitor interests, but I would wait until I actually need another cable.
ItemID: 10; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in Alexa is centered on home devices; I have no current need for an in-car assistant.
